entities.summary: Leader of Serbia (2000–2003 (President), 2004–2008 (PM)). DOS/DSS; defeated Milošević 2000 (Bulldozer Revolution); extradited him to Hague (reluctantly); nationalist but democratic; Kosovo independent under his PM (opposed)
